title: Lush Algerian Eggplant Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired stew made with tender eggplant, rich tagine sauce, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1-inch thick rounds and brush with olive oil.
Season the eggplant with salt and pepper.
Place the eggplant slices on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large saucepan, heat the tagine sauce over medium heat.
Add the roasted eggplant slices to the saucepan and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the peas and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with algerian spice blend and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
